commands.assertions: A not-delivered command is marked not_admitted and resumes with the same identity; a delivered command whose reply route expires is outcome_unknown and retry returns the original receipt; SQLite round-trip preserves the terminal receipt across store reopen.
Bridge packages compile and relay tests pass; the broad suite is blocked by existing agent-manager cli/manifest.json positional flag schema drift in internal/dispatch and internal/pairing.
Relay Reconcile is registered in the endpoint manifest; existing callback omissions are explicitly governed.

assertions: Command IDs are caller-owned and fingerprinted so a changed payload cannot reuse an existing identity.
A route that reports zero delivery records not_admitted; reusing the exact command ID is safe to resume.
A delivered command with a lost response is recorded as outcome_unknown and subsequent Call returns that receipt without another push.
The relay command journal is persisted in SQLite and loaded after reopening the store.
limitations: Live WAN relay cost/latency and attached-device grant revocation remain open (REM-07 and REM-08).
The broad Bridge suite still reports the pre-existing agent-manager manifest schema failure; no focused relay assertion failed.
